title: Demografi bilgisi toplama (Tek Kaynak)
purpose: Implements FR-E1-08: Demographics form (age required 13-120, gender optional, country required via searchable dropdown) before first content start. Not re-asked if already submitted. Editable from Profile > Settings.

inputs.name: existingProfile
inputs.note: Pre-fills form if demographics were previously submitted (AC-FR-E1-08-06)

loading.description: Skeleton fields for age, gender toggle buttons, and country dropdown with disabled Save button.

ready.description: Age number input (13-120 validation), gender toggle group (Kadin/Erkek/Belirtmek istemiyorum), searchable country dropdown, info card explaining data purpose, and Save button.

empty.description: Pre-filled form if profile exists (AC-FR-E1-08-06); otherwise clean form with required field markers.

error.description: Inline validation errors for age out-of-range. Network error banner with retry for submission failures.

offline.description: Form editable with cached countries list. Submission queued for sync on reconnect. Offline banner shown.
